blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Lucban municipal government in Quezon province urged residents to conserve water as traditional spring sources reach critically low levels due to El Niño. “The public is respectfully informed that, due to the effects of El Niño, water levels in our spring water sources have reached critically low levels. As a result, water pressure has weakened, causing reduced water flow or, in some areas, a complete loss of water supply from faucets,” the local government said in a water advisory on Wednesday.
